items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: And at that time he had me playing on one track electric bass.

ctx.x: With Lalo, I don’t think I would have been able to work with Michel. First of all, to have some sense of dealing with an orchestra. And then specifically about Michel, it has been ten years of, most of the time, always a challenge. But I would say a fantastic, profound, and so high demanding challenge. But you go for it.
